We are seeking an experienced SQL Developer with French language skills to join our team. 
 Job description: 
Working with complex data catalogs involving multiple objects and tables, relationships, and cardinalities.
Operating in high-volume data environments, handling hundreds of millions of rows per day and APIs processing approximately 2 million calls per hour.
Supporting demanding production environments with incident-resolution SLAs of less than four hours.
Handling cross-functional requests related to data exposure and accessibility.
Providing technical support to a broad range of stakeholders, including architects, business analysts, and developers. 
Modeling publicly exposed data using technologies and standards such as Swagger and Avro.
Designing internal data tables optimized for efficient read and write operations.
 You need to know: 
Strong SQL skills and solid experience with Java (>17)
Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience with technologies such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Oracle EXACC, Spark, Kubernetes, Starburst, Airflow, Python, ELK monitoring, and Docker
Advanced French knowledge
Performance tuning, optimization, and profiling
Strong attention to detail, autonomy, and a proactive approach to identifying and proposing solutions.
Ability to communicate progress and provide clear updates on assigned activities.
Customer-focused mindset with strong collaboration and problem-solving skills.
Results-oriented, with the ability to work effectively across teams and stakeholders.
 Hybrid work with 3 days in the office in either Bucharest/Timisoara/Cluj/Brasov 
 Why should you join us? 
We have a solid company (projects that last minimum one year), and employees stay with us on average for about 10 years
We have many projects (50+) and lots of career opportunities. After you finish your first project, for the next one you can choose to master the skills that you already know, or learn new technologies on the next one. This way, you do not have to change the company, just the project
Reimbursement of agreed certifications
Private medical subscription
Team buildings.
